result.paraphrase: Seagate Exos 7E2000 2TB internal hard drive, part number ST2000NX0253, is a 2.5-inch SATA 6Gbps HDD in the Exos 7E2000 line. It offers 2 TB of storage, 512-byte sectors, 1.4 million-hour MTBF, PowerChoice on-demand power, protection information, low-halogen construction, RAID rebuild support, and AFR of 0.63%. Performance details include a 136 MB/s maximum sustained transfer rate, 4.16 ms average latency, 6.0/3.0/1.5 GB/s interface speeds, a single port, 128 MB buffer, and 7200 RPM rotation. Compatible with 1 x internal 3.5-inch x 1/4H bay.
